claims.evidence: photo 0 shows headlight assemblies only; witness recorded brand and model as null and lists the car make/model they fit as not shown.

risks.risk: Headlights may not work or may have cracked lenses.
risks.proof: Video clip of each assembly switched on, plus a close-up of every lens.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working with cracked lenses (worst case).

risks.risk: They may not fit a Honda Accord 2003/2007.
risks.proof: Photo of any part number or branding, or fitment confirmation for Honda Accord 2003–2007.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic assemblies with unknown fit (worst case).

risks.risk: Bulbs and wiring may not be included.
risks.proof: Shot showing bulbs and wiring harnesses with the assemblies.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as housings only, without bulbs or wiring.

risks.risk: Mounting points or adjusters may be broken.
risks.proof: Close-up of mounting tabs, brackets and adjuster screws on each unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having damaged mounts or adjusters (worst case).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any branding, part number or model marking on the headlights.
Video of the headlights powered on to confirm they work.
Close-up of mounting points, brackets and adjusters on each assembly.
Confirmation that bulbs and wiring harnesses are included.
Count and individual condition of each assembly in the pile.
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as used car headlight assemblies, so they can be priced at the worst case; unproven fitment and function are listed as risks with the proof that would raise the value.
